sn35.123:1.1: Upādāniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi upādānañ ca || tam suṇātha || || Katame ca bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā katamam upādānaṃ || || Santi bhikkhave- -ime vuccanti bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā || || Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānan ti || || Lokakāmaguṇavaggo dutiyo || ||
sn35.123:2.0: Tassuddānam || || Mārapāsena dve vuttā || || Lokakāmaguṇena ca || || Sakko Pañcasikho ceva || Sāriputto ca Rāhulo || Saṃyojanaṃ Upādānaṃ || || Vaggo tena pavuccatīti || ||
